about: The topic taxonomy (PRD 4.5 G1). The tags are the topic_tag.schema.json enum. The tagger maps the interest-chat answer to at most 2 of them; the Writer reads the description and the genre. A request's genre is EXPOSITORY only when every tag is factual and no genre_hint is given; otherwise NARRATIVE.

tags.description: animals at home, on the farm or in the wild
the sun, the moon, the stars and rockets
buying and selling at the market
cars, buses, bikes, trains and boats
sun, rain, wind and the seasons
exploring, journeys and finding things out
